heroTitlePrefix: What are we signing up for
heroDescription: Every day is a new opportunity to move, improve and feel better. Choose your plan, book your class and start training with purpose.
facilitiesTitle: A space designed for your peak performance
facilitiesDescription: State-of-the-art equipment, bright and spacious areas, and every detail crafted so you can focus solely on your workout.
facilitiesMainCardDesc: Professional racks, Olympic barbells, and dumbbells of all weights.
facilitiesCard2Desc: Treadmills, ellipticals, and climbers with interactive screens.
facilitiesCard3Desc: Climate-controlled space with acoustics and lights for high energy.
facilitiesCard4Desc: A spot to hydrate, socialize, and refuel your energy.
facilitiesCtaText: Come check it out. Book a trial class and experience GymTup from day one.
classesTitle: Find the discipline that moves you
classesDescription: From yoga to breathe better to strength training to build a solid foundation. Every class adds to your plan.
machinesTitle: All the machines you need, in one place
machinesDescription: No waiting lines and constant maintenance. Each zone is built for safe, top-tier workouts.
machineFreeWeightsDesc: Dumbbells, Olympic bars, and racks for strength and hypertrophy.
machineGuidedDesc: Pulleys and selectorized equipment to isolate every muscle group.
machineCardioDesc: Treadmills, ellipticals, and rowers with screens and interval programs.
machineSpinningDesc: Spin bikes with resistance control and power tracking.
ctaTitle: Your next best version starts today
ctaDescription: Choose a plan based on how many classes you want to take and join the GymTup community.
